intent: Cut the final direct-child SADHANA R2 deployment candidate from the integrated safety parent. Preserve the explicit unmerged deployment class, exact-byte admission, globally pristine paused projection, immutable observer API, authenticated bounded mobile-control membrane, private Unix-socket dashboard, held-out oracle sandbox, root-owned clean-host custody, hardened systemd topology, private-only Tailscale routes, exact-end stop timers, append-only SQLite-online-backup replication, and a renewable live port-2222 forced-rrsync proof. Megh is the sole writer; AGNI remains masked and fenced; failover is manual; reboot is terminal; no public listener or unrestricted mobile shell is admitted.

commit.message: feat(ops): finalize fenced SADHANA R2 deployment

interface_mismatches: A deployment candidate is not a merged canonical release; the sealed manifest must retain the explicit unmerged-deployment-candidate class and canonical_or_merged=false.

The same seven-seat SADHANA mind and durable campaign can be operated from mobile, but a private bounded dashboard is not this transient Codex conversation and is not an unrestricted shell or general chat surface.

A prepared PAUSED projection is observer bootstrap evidence, not dispatch or provider authority. Typed activation requires ResumeAuthorized(PreparedPaused(seq=1), DispatchEnabled(release,authenticated-account-ui-confirmation)) to yield Active(seq=2, NoExternalEffect) only after writer-lock, read-only boot, exact-roster, capacity, clock, route, and authenticated-account checks.

Normal pause/resume admission must be bound to the volatile sequence-2 activation epoch at both HTTP and supervisor reconciliation boundaries; emergency stop remains a distinct predispatch transport and root authority.

Tailscale SSH owns AGNI tailnet port 22, while ordinary OpenSSH forced-rrsync is reachable only through an exactly owned port-2222 Serve handler. The release must prove that exact route live, reject interactive, arbitrary-command, traversal, protect-args, and transport-failure substitutes, and forbid proof renewal after dispatch.
A renewable capacity claim must preserve the full ordered snapshot ledger as an exact prefix. Count-only, truncated, deleted, substituted, or post-marker renewal evidence cannot promote dispatch.

systemd namespace admission does not create persistent oracle roots. Exact root and service custody must exist before the isolated unit starts, and hostile links or foreign paths must be rejected rather than repaired.

A host reboot invalidates the volatile activation epoch and is terminal for this canary; retained markers, process health, or standby bytes cannot silently recreate provider authority or transfer writer standing.
A warrant denial may be epistemically blocked while its idempotency effect attempt is terminally failed; those modalities must remain distinct for replay safety.
A typed no-effect preparation requires GlobalDispatchRows(before) and GlobalDispatchRows(after) both empty; campaign-local emptiness is insufficient.

VerifiedHMAC(AllowedTailnetAccount, ExactOrigin, Release, PredispatchGate, ClientReportedUiFacts):NoEffect may promote only to AuthenticatedAccountUiConfirmation; it is not a subtype of PhysicalMobileAttestation, HumanIdentityAttestation, HumanPresenceAttestation, or ServerMeasuredViewport.

CandidateScanObserved(EmptyNormalInbox, EmptyEmergencyInbox):NoAuthority is not a subtype of CommitAtomicEmpty. The never-emitted authenticated-account UI candidate v2 may state only control_inboxes_empty_at_last_prepublication_scan=true; root promotion independently inventories both inboxes before candidate read and after freeze, rejects any intervening control write, and leaves that request unconsumed.

ExactMainUnitBytes is not a subtype of EffectiveSystemdAuthority. Promotion requires ImmutableTemplateBytes + ExactFragmentPath + EmptyDropInPaths + NeedDaemonReload(false) + ExactLoadedIdentitySandboxEnvironmentExecFlags, proved before and after root daemon-reload and rechecked at the dispatch marker boundary.

Replacing the mobile receipt field inside campaign_activation.v1 is admissible only because this unmerged candidate has never emitted that schema on either target. Any pre-existing campaign_activation.v1 receipt is a hard deployment stop; a migrated live wire would require a schema bump instead of silent reinterpretation.
honest_blockers: Local gates cannot prove remote systemd, Tailscale ACL, DNS, SSH host-key, provider quota, or actual phone reachability; exact live canaries remain mandatory before dispatch.

No supported CLI accepts an arbitrary candidate path or operator boolean; the admitted producer is the fixed private same-origin endpoint. Its receipt proves the allowlisted Tailscale account plus exact origin/release bindings and records client-reported 390px, coarse-touch, gesture, and browser isTrusted flags. It does not prove browser integrity, a physical device, human identity, human presence, or a server-measured viewport. Deployment may proceed safely through paused predispatch, while sequence 2 and provider work remain locked until that bounded confirmation is promoted before expiry.

The release script never auto-promotes AGNI and intentionally offers no automatic failover command; any later promotion requires a distinct human-authorized packet after Megh fencing and fresh snapshot inspection.

The installer never creates or discloses secret values. Mode-0600 environment and credential inputs, pinned known-hosts, post-bootstrap runtime manifests, oracle evidence, fresh capacity evidence, and a live renewable replication-route proof remain activation inputs.
A passing closeout, review council, and release seal establish bounded artifact evidence, not merge authority, useful-work completion, or multi-model truth by consensus.

The final generated inventory and sovereign count refresh are owned by the active repository-titanium track. This code packet must close first, then an immediate separately governed DocOps child must pass integrity before the release is sealed.
No VPS, provider, public route, external account, or remote Git ref is mutated before this packet is closed, reviewed, and sealed.
session_entry.rollback: Run the exact writer rollback command to stop the static dispatch target first, then fence predispatch, emergency recovery, and the deadline timer; prove every campaign unit and listener quiet; remove only unchanged release-owned Tailscale handlers and the exact writer marker; retain release, oracle, activation, route, snapshot, and stop evidence; leave AGNI masked and fenced; and publish the immutable restart-denial receipt. Drift preserves disputed resources for manual review instead of broad reset or deletion.
